# Executive summary


---
<!-- trackio-cell
{"type": "markdown", "id": "cell_d54491159369", "created_at": "2026-07-21T16:05:07+00:00", "title": "Executive summary", "pinned": true, "pinned_at": "2026-07-21T16:04:55+00:00"}
-->
Claims 1-3 reproduce within the released-data CPU scope; Claims 4-6 remain unreplicated. Claim 1 recomputes the released benchmark and audits its construction source; Claim 2 aggregates released oracle outputs without rerunning the paid oracle calls; Claim 3 runs one deterministic official-evaluator case per released trajectory plus a residual fixture, not a full per-action online rollout. The independent [Hugging Face Job `wrice/6a61607c13e6ef894d54c828`](https://huggingface.co/jobs/wrice/6a61607c13e6ef894d54c828) ran on `cpu-basic` for 61 running seconds (71 seconds total), passed all 65 focused tests, and its [portable outputs](https://huggingface.co/buckets/wrice/nape-cpu-job-evidence-7220279/tree/nape-7220279222f1-claims-1-3) matched a fresh local bundle byte-for-byte. The estimated CPU compute cost is ≈$0.000169 (61 s × $0.01/hour), with $0.00 paid-model API cost; the Hub exposed no final bill. This attempt was CPU-only: autonomous GPU work was outside the allowed loop, and full Claims 4-6 also require unavailable outputs or cache replay plus authorized paid live GPT-5 calls, so no GPU or provider proxy result is reported.

## Scope & cost

|  | This reproduction | Full replication |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | Released-artifact/output recomputation for Claims 1-2; one evaluator case per trajectory plus a residual fixture for Claim 3 | Regenerate model outputs and run the full paper protocols for Claims 1-6 |
| Hardware | Hugging Face `cpu-basic` | Paid live GPT-5 provider; GPU-backed empirical work if self-hosted; exact paper hardware not released |
| Compute time | 61 running seconds (71 seconds total) | Not released; not attempted |
| Cost | ≈$0.000169 estimated (`61 s × $0.01/hour`); $0.00 paid-model API | Unknown; paid inference required |
| Outcome | Claims 1-3 supported only in the stated released-data/mechanism scope | Claims 4-6 not attempted; no empirical verdict |
